purpose: Permanent passive registry for revenue probes, diagnostics, and adjacent commercial experiments.
money_claim_rule: No revenue is recognized unless an external live Stripe paid Checkout Session is matched to a registered offer.

experiments.hypothesis: Businesses will pay for evidence-first review of agentic commerce trust gaps.
A low-ticket readiness audit can convert uncertainty into a paid implementation path.
Users will pay to turn personal agent permissions into an explicit commerce policy.
Evidence monitoring is valuable enough to support a low-friction recurring rail.
Customers will pay monthly for recurring evidence analysis and prioritization.
High-value operational evidence work can support a recurring operator tier.
The private factory can sell bounded architecture audits without exposing private implementation material.
The historical MTG diagnostic signal remains monetizable while staying isolated from the DreamLedger agentic-commerce thesis.

permanent_rules: A checkout link is not revenue evidence.
Test payments never count as revenue.
Paid live Stripe evidence is the settlement authority.
Every observed economic event gets a deterministic event identifier.
No public publication is triggered by this module.
No offer is activated by this module.
No silo may consume another silo's customer or evidence data.
A failed or inconclusive experiment is still recorded as evidence.
